long_description: Acyclic runs agent swarms. Hand it a task from the CLI, the dashboard, or a coding agent over MCP, and it splits the work across many agents, each in its own sandbox, then merges what they produce into one result. Long agentic workflows finish in a fraction of the wall-clock time. Bring your own model keys or run the sandboxes in your own cloud; the harness underneath is open source. Coding is the first workload, and research and data work run the same way. Founded by Ram Vinjamuri and Varun Latthe. YC F26, London.
name: Acyclic Labs
one_liner: Rapid agent swarms: make any agentic workflow exponentially faster
